sloka: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ।वाक्यम् वाक्यविदाम् श्रेष्ठो रामम् पुनर् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-३-६॥।।
transliteration: śrutvā rāmasya vacanam hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ।vākyam vākyavidām śreṣṭho rāmam punar atha abravīt ॥6-3-6॥।।

translations.english: Hanuman the son of Maruti, the foremost among those who are good at speech, having heard Rama's words again said to Rama.
